You are being evaluated on Continual-ARC, a lifelong stream of ARC-style grid puzzles.
Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:
  {"action": "submit", "grid": [[0, 1, 2], [3, 4, 5]]}   submit an output grid
  {"action": "request_demos"}                            ask for one more demonstration pair for this task
  {"action": "finish"}                                   end the instance, once it is over
Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: every wrong submission costs 1 and every demo request costs 1. An
instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt cap is reached, and
reaching the cap is charged the full cap. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

In your continual harness, entries created without global_=True belong to this session and are lost with it.

import re, numpy as np
# parse all demo pair input/output from records texts
texts=[records[i]['message']['content'][0]['text'] for i in (7,9)]
demos=[]
for tx in texts:
    for j in (1,2):
        # use blocks lines after marker to next marker
        marker=f'Demo pair {j} input'
        if marker not in tx: continue
        start=tx.index('\n',tx.index(marker))+1
        end=tx.index(f'Demo pair {j} output')
        # input dims line is part of marker; pull grid lines
        inp_lines=tx[start:end].strip().splitlines()
        # marker line includes dims; we start right after line so good
        start2=tx.index('\n',tx.index(f'Demo pair {j} output'))+1
        end2=tx.find('\n\nSame instance',start2)
        if end2<0: end2=len(tx)
        out_lines=tx[start2:end2].strip().splitlines()
        # limit rows based dims from marker
        dims=re.search(r'input \((\d+)x(\d+)\)',tx[tx.index(marker):tx.index('\n',tx.index(marker))])
        R,C=map(int,dims.groups())
        inp=[list(map(int,x.split())) for x in inp_lines[:R]]
        out=[list(map(int,x.split())) for x in out_lines[:R]]
        assert all(len(x)==C for x in inp+out), (j, [len(x) for x in inp], [len(x) for x in out])
        demos.append((np.array(inp),np.array(out)))
for a,b in demos:
    print(a.shape, np.sum(a!=b), np.argwhere(a!=b).tolist())

records=[json.loads(l) for l in p.read_text().splitlines()]
tx=records[9]['message']['content'][0]['text']
for label in ['Demo pair 2 input','Demo pair 2 output']:
    pos=tx.index(label)
    line_end=tx.index('\n',pos)
    linesx=tx[line_end+1:]
    if label.endswith('input'):
        linesx=linesx[:linesx.index('Demo pair 2 output')]
    else:
        linesx=linesx[:linesx.index('\n\nSame instance')]
    rows=[list(map(int,s.split())) for s in linesx.strip().splitlines()[:17]]
    row=rows[14]
    print(label,len(row),[(i,x) for i,x in enumerate(row)], ''.join('#' if x==4 else '.' for x in row))
    if label.endswith('input'): ai=np.array(rows)
    else: bo=np.array(rows)
print('diffs',np.argwhere(ai!=bo).tolist())
